title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
abstract: arXiv:2610.28579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. translated_title: 面向空间转录组学的空间信息感知与方向敏感的表征学习
translated_abstract: 细胞状态由内在的基因表达程序和细胞所处的空间微环境共同塑造。空间转录组学使这种背景环境可被测量，但有效的表征学习需要同时捕捉具有空间信息的分子信号和细胞间的组织结构。现有方法仅能部分解决这些挑战：传统的基因选择方法可能会忽略具有空间结构的信号，而编码细胞-细胞关系的方法通常要么将细胞的微环境简化为仅考虑邻近性而丢弃方向信息，要么依赖于与任意组织坐标系绑定的绝对坐标。因此，具有相似邻居距离但空间组织方式不同的细胞可能会获得过于相似的表征，尽管它们所处的塑造其细胞状态的生物学背景各不相同。我们提出了Tessera，一个空间表征学习框架，它解决了……
tldr: 提出Tessera空间表征学习框架，通过捕捉空间信息丰富的分子信号和方向敏感的细胞间关系，克服了现有方法忽略空间结构信号和方向信息的局限。
en_tdlr: Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework for spatial transcriptomics that captures both spatially informative molecular signals and direction-sensitive cell-cell relationships, overcoming the limitations of existing approaches.
